svg.title: Partbench professional CAD feature map
svg.desc: 339 features across 27 areas: 27 Done and 312 Not done. One square per feature. Filled green squares with a check mean Done; outlined squares mean Not done. The README checklist provides every feature as text.

g.text: Professional CAD, one feature at a time.
